title: The Lighthouse Poem
text:
A lighthouse poem often uses one steady image to express a larger feeling. The poet describes a beacon that keeps shining through the storm. Each line returns to the light, so the reader begins to see it as a symbol of hope.

Although the sea is dark and rough, the speaker never mentions fear directly. Instead, the poem uses calm and repeated sounds. Many students find that this quiet style makes the final line more powerful.

questions.text: What does the beacon do in the first paragraph?
options: It keeps shining through the storm

questions.text: What does the speaker avoid doing in the second paragraph?
Why might the poet repeat the image of the light?
options: To suggest that hope continues throughout the poem

questions.text: What can be inferred about the quiet style in the poem?
options: It hides the poem's emotional impact
It makes the emotions feel more controlled and powerful
It shows the poet is angry
It means the poem has no clear meaning

vocabulary.definition: a light used to guide or warn people, such as at sea
staying the same and not changing or shaking
an object or image that represents a larger idea

paragraph_translations: Поема про маяк часто використовує один стабільний образ, щоб передати ширше почуття. Поет описує маяк, який продовжує світити крізь шторм. Кожен рядок повертається до світла, тож читач починає бачити в ньому символ надії.
Хоча море темне й бурхливе, мовець ніколи прямо не згадує страх. Натомість поема використовує спокій і повторювані звуки. Багато учнів помічають, що така тиха манера робить останній рядок сильнішим.
